extDescription.message: Right-click web images to recognize text locally on macOS and translate via any OpenAI-compatible API.

inputHint.message: Drop, upload, or paste an image, right-click a web image, or paste a

statusInitial.message: Right-click a web image, or upload/paste an image.

routeOnlyOcrReselect.message: OCR only · Please re-select mode in Settings

statusNoClipboardImage.message: No image in clipboard. Copy or capture an image first.

statusPasteHint.message: Press ⌘V to paste an image from the clipboard.

statusCopyFailed.message: Could not write to clipboard. Please copy the text manually.

statusBgUnavailable.message: Could not connect to extension background. Upload or paste an image instead.

targetHelp.message: Choose a target language or select Custom to enter a language code like en-US.

targetInvalid.message: Enter a valid language tag such as zh-Hans or ja.

apiBaseUrlHelp.message: Base URL for a cloud or local translation service.

apiBaseUrlInvalid.message: Enter a valid HTTPS URL or local HTTP URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1).

modelInvalid.message: Enter a valid model name without spaces or line breaks.

statusSettingsSaveFailed.message: Failed to save settings. Please try again.

statusReselectMode.message: Previous mode is unrecognized. Please select and save again.

statusOcrLangUnavailable.message: Selected OCR language is no longer available. Please save again.

statusOcrLangTimeout.message: Timed out loading OCR languages. Reopen Settings to retry.

statusSettingsLoadFailed.message: Failed to load settings. Reopen this page.

apiDescription.message: When translating, only the recognized text is sent to your configured translation service.

keyHelp.message: Stored securely on this Mac; optional for unauthenticated local services.

keyStatusTimeout.message: Timed out checking key status. Reopen Settings.

keyStatusSaveTimeout.message: Timed out saving key. Check macOS Keychain and retry.

err_native_missing.message: Native helper not found or failed to start. Run ./scripts/install.sh and try again.

err_native_failed.message: Native helper exited unexpectedly. Retry or re-run ./scripts/install.sh.

err_native_timeout.message: Local operation timed out. Try a smaller image or check the translation service.

err_invalid_request.message: Invalid request parameters. Check Settings and retry.

err_image_read.message: Cannot read this page image. Upload, paste an image, or paste a macOS screenshot.

err_image_read_reload.message: Cannot read this page image. If you just reloaded the extension, refresh the page first, or upload/paste a screenshot.

err_image_size.message: Image exceeds 8 MiB. Crop or resize it and retry.

err_image_dimensions.message: Image exceeds 40M pixels or 12,000 px per side. Resize it and retry.

err_invalid_image.message: Corrupted or unsupported image. Save as PNG or JPEG and retry.

err_ocr_language.message: Selected recognition language is unsupported on this Mac. Choose Auto-detect or another language.

err_ocr_failed.message: OCR failed. Try resizing or converting the image.

err_source_limit.message: Recognized text exceeds 16 KiB. Crop the image into smaller sections.

err_cloud_consent.message: Start translation from the image context menu or the Translate button.

err_missing_key.message: Save your API key in Settings, then click Translate Text.

err_invalid_key.message: Enter a valid API key without spaces or line breaks.

err_keychain.message: Cannot access macOS Keychain. Unlock it and retry.

err_network.message: Connection to the translation service failed. Check your network and API URL.

err_request_timeout.message: Translation request timed out. Check the service or try shorter text.

err_http_auth.message: Translation service rejected authentication (401/403). Verify your API key.

err_http_balance.message: API account balance or quota exhausted (402).

err_http_not_found.message: Translation endpoint or model not found (404). Check API Base URL and Model.

err_http_rate.message: Translation service rate limit reached (429). Please retry shortly.

err_http_server.message: Translation service server error (5xx). Please retry shortly.

err_provider_error.message: Translation service could not complete the request. Please retry.

err_empty_translation.message: Translation service returned empty output. You can retry.

err_incomplete_stream.message: Translation stream interrupted. Partial text can be copied, or retry.

err_translation_truncated.message: Model output limit reached. Partial text can be copied; try a smaller region.

err_bad_response.message: Invalid translation response format. Please retry.

err_output_limit.message: Translation response exceeded size limit. Try translating a smaller region.
